verdict.rationale: Foreloop is an AI-driven SaaS that reads customers' code and feedback submissions, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers data-use policy, model-training exclusion, or an opt-out control. The API-key and approval-gate items concern access control and task execution, not training data use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
